mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RAP.application ( application_name, application_code, description, owner_name, owner_email, university_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{applicationName}, #{applicationCode}, #{description}, #{ownerName}, #{ownerEmail}, #{universityId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE RAP.application SET application_name = #{applicationName}, description = #{description}, owner_name = #{ownerName}, owner_email = #{ownerEmail}, updated_at = GETDATE(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE RAP.application SET application_name = #{applicationName}, description = #{description}, owner_name = #{ownerName}, owner_email = #{ownerEmail}, university_id = #{universityId}, updated_at = GETDATE(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.university_id, u.university_name, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
WHERE a.application_code = #{applicationCode}

SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
WHERE sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_CODE = #{status} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
WHERE a.application_name LIKE '%' + #{namePattern} + '%' ORDER BY a.application_name
mapper.sql: FROM RAP.application a LEFT JOIN RAP.university u ON a.university_id = u.id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 waa.STATUS_CD FROM RAP.WORKFLOW_APP_ASSOC waa WHERE waa.APP_ID = a.id AND waa.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY waa.CREATE_DT DESC ) latest_assoc LEFT JOIN RAP.GENERIC_REF_TBL sts ON sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_ID = latest_assoc.STATUS_CD
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.university_id, u.university_name, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
WHERE a.owner_email = #{userEmail} AND (sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_CODE IS NULL OR sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_CODE <> 'ACCEPTED') ORDER BY a.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WHERE a.owner_email = #{userEmail} AND sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_CODE = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT a.id, a.application_name, a.application_code, a.description, sts.GENERIC_REF_TBL_DESC AS status, a.owner_name, a.owner_email, a.university_id, u.university_name, a.created_at, a.created_by, a.updated_at, a.updated_by
